title: Streaming updates that cross an hour and a local midnight
policy: P3: an operation belongs to the hour of its first record; later growth is added there.
derivation: msg_03a: 15:59:58Z then 16:00:03Z, output 50 -> 90: [100, 90] in hour 15 UTC (Mar 10 08 PDT). msg_03b: 06:59:59Z (Mar 9 23:59:59 PDT) then 07:00:02Z (Mar 10 00:00:02 PDT), output 5 -> 25: [10, 25] in hour 06 UTC, which starts Mar 9 23:00 PDT, so Mar 9. Mar 9 = 35, Mar 10 = 190; today 190; week and month 225.
